gid.description: Its primary group ID; a group of its own when it is 0

groups.description: The groups it is a member of, besides its primary group

name.description: The user to add, such as alice

password.description: Its password, which osapi hashes on the controller; none when empty. A secret: a reference, secret://<vault>/<key>, or the value.

shell.description: Its login shell, such as /bin/bash; the system's default when empty

system.description: Add it as a system user, with an ID from the system range

uid.description: Its numeric user ID; the system assigns one when it is 0
